--- CLI contract: usage errors ---
Both must exit 2, and say why on stderr.

=== $ python3 regenpre.py --root no_such_dir_xyz ===
regenpre.py: --root is not a directory: no_such_dir_xyz
exit=2

=== $ python3 regenpre.py --phase nonsense --root .. ===
regenpre.py: unknown --phase: nonsense
exit=2

--- end to end over the fixture repository ---
The test module builds a small repository with one manifest entry, one
baseline and one capture.sh. Below it is built in a temp directory and
regenpre is run against it for real -- a clean pass (exit 0), then the
deliberately-broken variant (exit 1). The report is filtered to the
fields that are stable so this record stays reproducible; the raw
report is what the unit tests assert on.

=== $ python3 fixture_demo.py ===
good_fixture=True cli_exit=0 failing=0 counts={"drift": 0, "environment": 0, "error": 0, "match": 2, "volatile_only": 1}
   baselines    base-tool              match
   manifest     gen-tool:report.json   match
   transcripts  tx-tool                volatile_only
good_fixture=False cli_exit=1 failing=2 counts={"drift": 2, "environment": 0, "error": 0, "match": 1, "volatile_only": 0}
   baselines    base-tool              drift
   manifest     gen-tool:report.json   match
   transcripts  tx-tool                drift
exit=0
